identity.name: Remotely
identity.mission: Zero friction remote job discovery. Dark mode only. Data-first. No fluff.
identity.aesthetics: Cyber-Minimalism. Think 'Linear' meets 'Blade Runner' but for HR.
principles: Dark Mode Mandatory: Interface lives in the shadows (Zinc 950+).
Data Density: High density lists, expandable details. No massive whitespace for the sake of it.
Speed: Instant filtering, instant loading. The UI must feel 'snappy'.
Focus: The search bar is the protagonist. Everything else is supporting cast.

layout_strategy.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol - Mode B (High Density)
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous vertical rhythm (py-12, py-24), but tight component spacing (gap-4, gap-6).

SearchHero.description: Central command center. Large input, floating.
SearchHero.input_style: h-14 pl-12 bg-zinc-900/50 border-zinc-800 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-lg backdrop-blur-sm text-lg
SearchHero.icon_style: absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-500 w-5 h-5

JobCard.container: group relative flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-6 p-6 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/40 hover:bg-zinc-900/80 hover:border-zinc-700 transition-all duration-300
JobCard.logo_area: w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-400 shrink-0
JobCard.tag_style: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono bg-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-400 border border-zinc-800

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is Zinc-400 or lighter on Zinc-900 backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'job-search-input', 'apply-button').

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts. Align left for data, center only for hero headlines.
Never use pure black (#000000). Use Zinc-950 (#09090b) for depth.
Inputs and Cards must have a subtle border (Zinc-800).
Active states must be obvious (border color change or text color shift).
Use skeleton loaders (Shadcn Skeleton) instead of spinners for content loading.
instructions_to_main_agent: Configure 'tailwind.config.js' to include the custom Zinc/Indigo palette if not present, but prefer using standard Tailwind colors (Zinc) to keep bundle small.
Create a 'Layout' component that enforces the dark theme background (min-h-screen bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-50).
Use 'Manrope' from Google Fonts (via @import in index.css).
Build the Search component as a reusable organism.
Mock API calls for now, but structure the service layer for future axios integration.
